capabilities: : Edit notes simultaneously with live cursors
: Run a local peer-to-peer synchronization daemon
: Join collaboration sessions via web link
disambiguation: It uses a local daemon and peer-to-peer connection rather than relying on cloud services or central servers.
extras: Desktop only (Linux and macOS supported; Windows is not yet supported).
problem: Traditional note sharing lacks real-time, simultaneous editing capabilities across multiple users working on the same set of files.
summary: Live collaboration on Markdown notes in Obsidian using a peer-to-peer, serverless synchronization daemon.
